MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The outdoor Gorilla tape feels like a natural choice because I have used Gorilla tape before, and its weather resistance fits repairs involving ducting and clamps.",
    "The sealed wire connectors relate to my earlier electrical connector purchase and offer a useful option for wire repairs that need protection from moisture."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Workbench casters and magnets assume projects I have not shown a need for; buying a handtruck does not mean I need to modify a workbench or mount things.",
    "Nuts, screws, and gloves require the right size for a specific task. Their general usefulness does not give me a reason to choose these particular ones.",
    "Super glue and another scoop fit things I have bought, but ten tubes of glue feel excessive, and I have no current reason to replace my scoop."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My repair purchases seem to have been taken as interest in almost any workshop supply, even when the intended job is different.",
    "Similarity to something I already bought seems to count too heavily without considering whether I need more or whether the quantity makes sense."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The connection between my recent duct clamps and tape suited to outdoor repairs matters more to me than a broad connection to tools and hardware.",
    "I choose supplies for particular jobs, so connection type, dimensions, quantity, and whether I already own a usable item affect whether I would buy now."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my practical repair interests but too often assume that related supplies imply an immediate need."
}
